name: Bharatiya Global Infomedia Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Bharatiya Global Infomedia Ltd is in the business of Information Technology & IT based products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
BGIL provides turnkey solutions catering to Smart Cities including all major sectors or industries viz. Road & Transportation, Infra &Building, Health & Medical, Defence, Security & Surveillance, etc. It owns 19 registered IPR (Intellectual Property Rights) into Applications related to automation of Security, Surveillance & Safety, Communication (Mobile Applications). The company has upgraded its IT Products and started focusing on new emerging Industries like Medical & Science, Education & Transportation

pros: Stock is trading at 0.08 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
